source_excerpt: Singer Mika Singh has defended Daler Mehndi following the controversy surrounding his performance at a religious event in Uttarakhand. Mika questioned state minister Subodh Uniyal's reaction, claiming that the audience was enjoying the concert when the minister reportedly interrupted the performance. He also said concertgoers openly express their displeasure when they are unhappy with a singer's performance.Mika shared examples from his own experience to explain how audiences respond to live music. He noted that even established singers face criticism when their songs fail to engage listeners.
